verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is scoped API tokens: they can be limited to selected resources, set at Account, User, or Zone permission levels, and issued as account tokens. That covers a thin slice of centralized access control. Nothing in the pack documents team member/role management, Worker secrets, or environment-variable management. Missing for 10: team/member role-based access management, Worker secrets management, environment variable configuration, central multi-project config, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Select which resources the token is authorized to access.
After selecting a permissions group (Account, User, or Zone), choose what level of access to grant the token.
Both user tokens and account tokens are supported.
